claim_sentence_verbatim: The pinned adapter matches the hosted teacher [CI: A - H = +30.43 points on R@1 IoU 0.5, video-grouped 95% CI 16.67 to 41.79]. The gain over its own pinned base was not demonstrated on this set. No best-in-class wording.
negatives_disclosure_verbatim: the author team also built the system, so the negatives are adversarial, not random. The false-match rate measured on them is an upper-bound stress, not an average-case rate.
negatives_method_disclosure: absence confirmed against the licensed per-video annotation inventory (the positives' own ground truth), not visual review (the executing agent cannot view images) and not model descriptions; manifest sha256 daddd0e5cc31369da8dd4ca11e692d0984f8e09681c755e2afcb010ed2230a87, 20 entries, kept private
retrieval_diagnostics_note: pool-best top-1 IoU over the 12-candidate pool (raw equals reranked at top-1 for every arm with answered cases): H 57.23, H1 56.96, A 57.17 mean top-1 IoU percent; G 57.23 from a retrieval-only re-run over its completed index (zero model calls, raw pool only, no answered cases to rerank); the strict-verification path is measured against this strong ceiling, not against a ranked order
limits: 69 queries over 25 video groups; one query is 1.45 points; intervals are wide by construction
the 69 queries' prior exposure is disclosed in the protocol's honesty note; no untouched-held-out wording is used
hosted identities are unpinned; H's fingerprint matched the pilot's recorded teacher, H1's is recorded in ledger traces
arm A served without serving-layer grammar enforcement (multimodal guided-decoding gap); its validity comes from its trained contract, the same condition as its acceptance gate
H1's numbers are lower bounds on a stable contract; X's failure is a frozen-budget contract failure, not a capability claim; B's blocker is a serving-stack gap, not a base-model measurement

G's failure is an upstream schema-validation contract failure, not a GPT-6.1 capability claim: its description index built cleanly (25 of 25 videos), and its retrieval-only pools match the other arms (pool-best mean top-1 IoU 57.23 percent); only the strict verification stage could not run
